input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves User, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including user. The platform provides capabilities for report, user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As an Admin, I want to view reports and analytics, so that I can make informed business decisions.
